decisions.reason: It still has its own page, fits the firm’s core platform-and-analytics direction, and management is likely to continue backing a visibly launched product built on existing capabilities.

Its reduced website prominence suggests weaker traction, but because it remains close to the core tariff offering and prior development can be justified as still monetizable, management is likely to retain it for now.
Although it was downgraded from a standalone page to a mention, it builds on the established offer and can still be defended as a useful supporting module within the firm’s broader platform strategy.
